patches.new: ZIP_PREFIXES = ("train_set", "eval", "test")                        # FF dev-exclusion: dev_set.zip is never unpacked (original: ("train_set", "dev_set", "eval", "test")). organiser zips unpacked when not extracted

stage_ipy.rule: code cells of the original (CRLF->LF, empty cells skipped), drop_cells removed, patches applied in order with exact counts, each cell rstrip('\n') + cell_separator

consumers: t163b (RFS bundle, Experiment/RFS-01/train/assemble.py; reads no dev file)
verify_notes: compare with the frozen dataset (row cosine >= 0.999; same NaN pattern of the lane); dev arrays / dev index files of the frozen dataset are not written by this stage

post_checks.why: every v4-train and MAV-Celeb v1 / v2 array of the original run with its shape (20 arrays; values from package E nguynchnngn1__flag2027-feats-rfs-a-p.zip :: feats_manifest.json (created 2026-11-03 16:38), dev entries left out). A failed encoder (recorded in 'failed' and skipped) or a skipped MAV-Celeb source (ExtRows error only logged) leaves an array out, so the stage fails here instead of hours later downstream
MAV-Celeb v1 / v2 [face rows, voice rows] of the original manifest
